implementation_gate.name: stage2_joint_grpo_persistent_episode_v1_implementation
implementation_gate.scope: persistent live-episode rollout collection, balanced bucket visits, cross-step RuleMaker commitments, strict closed-environment checkpoint resume, v5 online artifacts, A/B fairness binding, focused regression, and one bounded real CUDA multi-group smoke

collection_semantics.per_live_episode: reset and warm up once, then collect consecutive fresh groups from successive usable states until a natural terminal, episode step cap, visit quota, bucket target, validation boundary, or total budget boundary
collection_semantics.per_group: sample one complete G-entry behavior-policy group, score raw tau_d, freeze advantages, perform every configured optimizer epoch when informative, then execute exactly one selected tau_cmd env.step
collection_semantics.bucket_fairness: deterministically balance the rollout budget over ordered scenario-by-seed buckets; visit at most ten groups before advancing
collection_semantics.validation_boundary: close the live environment before validation and checkpoint persistence
collection_semantics.resume: restore bucket targets, sample/update/episode counters, bucket cursor, partial visit progress, last validation index, and Torch generator state; do not serialize an active MetaDrive environment
collection_semantics.legacy_resume: checkpoints without the exact rollout collection contract are rejected

rule_maker_state_machine.active_commitment: advance against the current live pose and condition on committed actions while active; do not request a new proposal
rule_maker_state_machine.completed_commitment: clear external commitment state and allow a new proposal in the same decision step
rule_maker_state_machine.incompatible_feedback: execute the optimized safe STOP action while preserving an active commitment for the next step
rule_maker_state_machine.compatible_new_proposal: accept the matched proposal and retain its batch id and joint plan actions if it creates an active commitment
